name: Vado Corp.
summary: Vado Corp. provides advertising and technology services to agencies and brands in the United States. It offers tdX, an omnichannel trading desk platform, which delivers real-time campaign learnings and cross-channel performance; Admatx, a self-serve demand side platform; and AXi, a suite of audience intelligence tools. The company also provides tech-enabled creative services, which offers performance-oriented brand and product ad units, and other digital content for deployment within customer campaigns. Vado Corp. is headquartered in Beverly Hills, California.
